name: Verizon Fios TV
notes: Researched from public verizon.com Fios support FAQs and the public My Verizon sign-in page only (no sign-in). Sign-in is two-step: 'User ID or Verizon mobile number' (home customers enter a user ID, which may be their email) then Continue to the password; the page also offers Register, Forgot user ID or password and Make a one-time payment (guest pay; lookup fields not documented, family default kept). Pay: My Verizon > Home > Bills > Pay Bill; returned payments and late payments carry fees (amounts not stated on the pages used). Auto Pay: Bill > Auto Pay, choose method (bank, debit, credit or Verizon Visa) and a day of the month from the calendar, then Enroll. Discount: $10/month for select Fios TV or myHome Internet plans ($20 with both) with Auto Pay from a bank account or Verizon Visa Card plus paper-free billing. Paper-free: Paper Free Billing settings > Enroll / De-enroll; first and last bills are paper. Payment arrangements are self-service (pay by a date or split the past-due amount into 2 payments); a $7 Agent Assistance Fee applies when arranged with an agent by phone. Disconnect: My Verizon Account Settings > Disconnect > live chat with a representative, or 1-800-VERIZON (800-837-4966); ETF up to $350 decreasing $15/month; equipment back within 30 days. Cancel is reachable online via chat so cancel_service stays supported with a note. Plans and late fee amounts are not stated on the pages used and are left out.

help.title: How to pay your bill
paragraphs: Sign in to the My Verizon website or app and select Home, then Bills, then Pay Bill. If you are not registered, select Register, or use Make a one-time payment on the sign-in page.

Make sure the money is in your bank account on the date you schedule the payment: Verizon charges a fee for each returned payment and a late fee for payments that arrive after the due date shown on page one of your bill.

Fios TV customers with a compatible set-top box can also pay with the remote: press Menu, then Customer Support, My Account, Bill & Payment, Pay My Bill. You can also pay in person at a payment location.
steps: Select Pay Bill and follow the prompts.

help.title: Auto Pay and the Auto Pay discount
paragraphs: With Auto Pay, Verizon debits the method you choose (bank account, debit card, credit card or Verizon Visa Card) each month and emails or texts you the amount when the bill is ready. Keep paying until your first automatic payment is taken.

In My Verizon, select Bill, then Auto Pay, choose the payment method, pick the day of the month from the calendar, review and click Enroll after agreeing to the terms. You can change the method or date, or opt out, any time under Bill, Manage Auto Pay.

A monthly discount applies when Auto Pay uses a bank account or Verizon Visa Card together with paper-free billing on eligible plans: $10 a month for select Fios TV or myHome Internet plans, or $20 a month with both. Debit-card enrollments made before August 13, 2025 keep their discount.
steps: Sign in to My Verizon and select Bill, then Auto Pay.
Pick the day of the month for Auto Pay.
Review, agree to the terms and click Enroll.

help.title: Paper-free billing
paragraphs: Paper-free billing sends your monthly statement link by email or text instead of mailing a bill; your first and last bills are still on paper. Sign in to My Verizon, open the Paper Free Billing settings page and select Enroll. To stop, select De-enroll there, unless your plan requires paper-free billing.

help.title: Payment arrangements
paragraphs: A payment arrangement is a formal promise to pay your balance by a specific date, or to split a past-due amount into 2 payments, so your Fios service is not interrupted. It does not stop a late payment charge.

Set up or change an arrangement on the payment arrangement page in My Verizon (in the app: Me, Home, Bill overview, Payment Arrangements). It is free online or through the automated phone system; arranging, changing or cancelling one with an agent by phone adds a $7 Agent Assistance Fee.
If service is suspended, pay the past-due balance and it usually returns within an hour; otherwise call 1-800-Verizon (800-837-4966).

help.title: How to disconnect Fios service
paragraphs: Call 1-800-VERIZON (800-837-4966), Monday to Friday 8 AM to 7 PM ET or Saturday 8 AM to 5 PM ET, or disconnect online with a live chat agent: open Account Settings in My Verizon, select Disconnect, start the chat, type disconnect, choose Disconnect Fios home service and chat with a representative.

If you are under contract, a prorated early termination fee of up to $350 applies, dropping by $15 each month. Return rented equipment within 30 days to avoid an unreturned equipment charge. Auto Pay and paper-free billing stay on until your final payment, and credit balances are refunded within 60 days.
Going away for 30 days to 9 months? You can suspend service instead of cancelling.

extra.intent: Using the Verizon Fios support pages, find the monthly Auto Pay discount for an eligible Fios TV plan and which payment methods qualify. Do not change any settings or make a payment.
